status: bounded static provider and segment binding established; generalized saved-event placement remains gated
evidence_class: Original executable bytes, native disassembly and isolated REA/Ghidra analysis; no target execution or live-host observation.
result: The concrete VSTAudioChannel QueryInterface implementation accepts the same 128-bit IID address used by MAudioTrack, returns channel+0x15f8, and the returned interface setter stores MAudioTrack+0x120 into channel+0x1610.

The installed interface resolves to the already retained MAudioTrack segment selector/reset pair; the ordinary channel reader can therefore receive the concrete PAudioSegment descriptor produced by that track builder on this successful concrete-class path.

PAudioSegment getter +0xd8 returns stored binary64 start at +0x50, +0xf8 computes start+length from +0x50/+0x58, and +0x108 returns stored offset at +0x60. Source stream and Float32 gain occupy +0x38 and +0x68.

The native builder independently quantizes canonical start, end and source offset into its selected sample datum, then stores canonical-time descriptor coordinates. Its selected rate is an external provider value or an explicit 44100 fallback, not an automatic AudioFile-rate assertion.

Saved event start uses the containing context datum. Length and offset may select the event clip datum. This study does not authorize replacing all three by savedScalar/sampleRate or admitting arbitrary nonzero CPR positions.

query.condition: Both requested 64-bit words equal the two words at this IID address.
query.effect: Calls primary +0x8 retain; stores channel+0x15f8 into caller output; returns 0.

track_registration.condition: track+0xd8 exists, QI returns zero, returned interface is nonnull.

store.ownership: The store itself does not retain or release the provider. QI balances the temporary channel-interface reference; track/provider lifetime beyond this successful binding is not inferred.

selector.behavior: Fresh/stale cursor scans first segment whose computed end >= query, without a start check. Matching generation plus nonnull current returns its successor without re-evaluating query. Reset clears current and captures owner generation.

range_invalidation.effect: Rebuild first, query same IID, call interface+0x28 with preserved d0/d1 and w1=1; release interface.
range_invalidation.limits: This report does not assign an unproved unit to the invalidation range or the separately installed +0x128 helper.

provider_assignment.class_condition: The channel+0xd8 dynamic relation must be the captured concrete channel/QI path. This is not a claim that all host channels always have this class or that the same virtual slot on another class means the same operation.

setters.0xf0: 0x101a17cec subtracts existing start from end and clamps nonnegative before +0xe0

descriptor.distinction: This descriptor is not AClusterSegment; its three binary64 coordinates must not be replaced by the latter class's serialized integer fields.

path: reader uses channel+0x1610 selector/reset and descriptor start/end/offset getters
ordinary_reader_connection.read_operations: The retained reader constructs AudioAccessor via 0x10036e34c (flags0x25, policy1) and calls gain/seek/read virtual slots +0x160/+0x178/+0x168.
ordinary_reader_connection.numeric_contract: The separate timeline-reader study owns exact integer partitioning, global datum and seek/read order. No sample kernel or scheduler equivalence is asserted here.

saved_event_to_descriptor.status: Construction trace retained; broader nonzero saved-state projection is not admitted.
saved_event_to_descriptor.source_roles: Prior timebase/finding.json binds serialized MAudioEvent Start/Length/Offset to event getters. Start is converted from containing context datum; event-specific edit methods can choose the own-clip datum for delta length/offset.

context_start.order: event+0xe0 -> optional context+0xd0 transformation (after datum binding) -> binary64 add context+0x78 -> 0x101c22dc0 from context+0x50 datum to canonical10500f150.

context_length.order: event+0xf0 -> delta converter0x1016e39c8. Context end0x1016e2640 then adds context start and converted length.

context_offset.order: event+0x100 -> negate -> delta converter0x1016e39c8 -> negate. Do not simplify away signs/operation order for general floating-point inputs.

intersection.effect: Creates context, obtains S and E, skips S>=requestedEnd or E<=requestedStart; stores max(S,requestedStart), min(E,requestedEnd), event and context in range nodes.
intersection.normalization: 0x10020e7c8 handles overlaps/priorities. Only the singleton positive nonnegative interval publication branch is used here; general overlap semantics remain out of scope.

builder.effect: Builds/intersects ranges then invokes0x10020f2e8. A nonzero extra builder shift is added to published segment starts afterward.
builder.caller: 0x1002115a0 obtains the context via0x1016e6744; a conditional track+0x558 shift is a next-work binding, not presumed zero for arbitrary projects.

sample_datum.behavior: If owner+0x128 is nonnull, tailcall its slot0 and return the resulting Double. Otherwise return exact44100.
sample_datum.constructor: 0x101c225d0 tag10 dispatches through original jump table103ada008 to0x101c2267c, storing RN64(1/rate) at datum+8.
sample_datum.application_boundary: Using the source rate as this context is an explicit bounded reconstruction input, not a recovered global host default.

saved_event_to_descriptor.normal_remainder: The retained0x10020f2e8 branch converts range start/end and adjusted source offset to the selected sample datum, uses signed half adjustment followed by signed64 FCVTZS, then converts those integer coordinates back to canonical time before PAudioSegment start/end/offset setters. The offset includes the range-start minus original context-start adjustment. Fade/neighbour branches may change these integers earlier.
eligible_initial_subset: One direct source-bound audio event with verified zero ancestors, zero event start and zero source offset.
Verified clip datum, direct stereo PCM source and equal source/output rate under an explicitly supplied source-rate builder context.
Previously established no-fade/no-neighbour/no-loop/no-warp source gates remain required.
No overlap/priority or arbitrary folder-offset inference. The caller controls the reconstruction scope; omitted project content does not become playable implicitly.

next_discriminating_steps.required: Bind the actual restored context datum and recursive origin for the desired saved-event ancestry; compare a nonzero musical start against an own-clip sample offset to prevent conflating units.
Identify saved-state source/default and conditional activation of the extra start-only shift before admitting nonzero placement.
Bind the concrete provider and source/backend refresh for the broader scenario, or keep an explicit reconstruction context with strict matching checks.
Use clipped-start and overlapping-event controls before widening beyond one unclipped positive interval; preserve end and source-offset independent quantization.

disconfirming_checks: Wrong IID or unsuccessful/null QI must not be treated as provider installation.
A secondary offset other than0x15f8 or a setter displacement other than0x18 would break the observed channel+0x1610 identity.
A same-offset virtual call in PTimeView or MIDI Remote DTO is not evidence of this channel interface.
A segment whose end equals the selector query is selected by the retained >= predicate even if a half-open renderer subsequently produces no overlap.
Nonzero Start under containing datum0 must not be interpreted as raw clip frames; nonzero Length/Offset may use scalar datum10.
A differing builder rate, nonzero extra shift, overlap, neighbour/fade branch, transformed context or refreshed clip datum can invalidate the simple saved-event projection.
negative_discovery: Pass2 functions101ff6070/101ff825c/101ffe6bc and other same-slot candidates were retained but rejected as provider proof. Shared virtual-slot offsets alone do not bind dynamic receiver identity.
